selection.selection: Three previously unmeasured local BAL instances in three familiar dataset families, chosen before downloading or running; correlated family data, not independent capture domains. Sizes bound storage and runtime. No tuning.
selection.ablation_scope: all three scenes at primary target, including inactive controls; no outcome-driven scene substitution
selection.calibration: N3 guard-off Prism and Caspar FP64, 15 native seconds/600 outers, minimum independently audited endpoint, then freeze all targets before timing; calibration excluded from timings
selection.precision: original FP64 observations and common SIMPLE_RADIAL objective k2 fixed zero, independent FP64 exported-state audit
selection.timers: native solve including Prism local setup; external graph setup separately recorded; process wall includes loading/export excluded from native. CPU and GPU solvers serialized with local GPU lock.
selection.curvature_criterion: Curvature size must improve time at equal hit rate by >=1.10x on at least two guard-active instances and avoid >1.10x slowdown on any; otherwise no promotion or extra novelty claim. If fewer than two active instances, evidence insufficient.
limitations: Three new instances do not establish universal fastest
Ceres is CPU baseline, not evidence versus all GPU solvers
Existing Caspar snapshots are pinned implementations, not assertion of latest upstream

champion.label: sustained-eta2-lambda0.1
champion.status: best tested global configuration on six-scene fixed-target panel; defaults unchanged
limitations: Muell lambda10 + eta2 is a counterexample

cap_rule: A target qualifies only when reached inside native cap; Ceres may finish a current iteration beyond cap, which is retained and classified as late.
cap_limits: 600 accepted iterations for Prism versus 600 attempted for external solvers; native cap primary.
precision_buffer: Caspar FP32 native stop is 0.999 times registered target, with original-observation FP64 endpoint audit. This is conservative and disclosed.
state_policy: Every endpoint independently audited; generated state compressed losslessly then raw export removed after decompressed SHA check.
comparison_rule: Median/min-max only for 3/3 hits; retain misses, endpoint gaps, cap hits and invalid audits. No aggregate over a changing subset.
